**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644)  
**Order Date:** May 15, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**BMI Requirement:** Met. Current BMI is 35.0 kg/m² (documented 5/15/2025), meeting the minimum threshold of 35 or greater.

**Obesity-Related Comorbidity:** Met. Patient has documented essential hypertension, an obesity-related condition listed in our policy. Blood pressure readings confirm active diagnosis (systolic 134 mm Hg).

**Prior Weight Management:** Met. Medical record documents completion of a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program including dietitian visits and phentermine trial. Net weight loss of 2 kg was regained after discontinuation, and the treating physician documented this as unsuccessful.

**Covered Procedure:** Met. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass (CPT 43644) is a covered bariatric procedure.

---

This authorization is valid for 60 days from this letter. Please contact us if you have questions.
